wc-per.label: RCB recorded squad spend per win, 2018–2026
wc-per.dataset: CricField warehouse + CricField squads-by-season.json (auction and retention prices)
wc-per.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (%IDS%) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, COUNT(*) n FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (%IDS%) OR m.team2_id IN (%IDS%)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026 GROUP BY year
